sources.title: Polish GitHub Markdown and create the Annotate landing
sources.note: Approved direct implementation and shipment of compact GitHub presentation plus a lightweight landing in the existing mjshao.fun portfolio. No standalone Annotate landing previously existed. Reuse real captures and warm rust/charcoal identity; preserve published behavior, optional browser setup and Safari copy-only status. Exact session/message IDs are unavailable. Runtime/package release scope remains 0.13.1; visual-only follow-up waits for the next npm release.

sources.title: Synthetic review captures from the published 0.13.0 package
sources.note: Recorded the downloaded published native reviewer with VHS and the real unpacked Chrome extension with isolated headless Chromium. All document/page content, comments and destinations are synthetic. Browser capture shows panel.html in a background tab with a test receiver, not Chrome's native sidebar frame or a real model response. No feedback was sent, no private transcript or third-party toolbar artwork was captured. Reproduction and limits are in docs/assets/README.md.

sources.title: Improve discovery for OpenCode Annotate searches
sources.quote: my annotate clearly outperforms others when people can search for opencoe annotate, lets seo
sources.note: Approved the proposed GitHub/npm-first discoverability pass: clearer positioning, relevant metadata, authentic demo captures and concise workflows. The user's report that leading search results do not work well is personal experience, not an independently verified competitor benchmark. Exact session/message IDs are unavailable in this harness. No standalone website or unrelated unpublished runtime changes are included.

sources.title: Render selected local artwork in the native annotation toolbar
sources.quote: dont just map, i d liketo see it actually in tui
sources.note: The user requested actual locally supplied PNGs, then accepted compact one-row sizing and requested original action-colored bold shortcuts. Exact message IDs are not exposed by the harness. Artwork is user-supplied and remains outside source and distributed artifacts; Unicode is the unconfigured default.

sources.title: Release the accepted TUI toolbar and Safari companion together
sources.note: Authorizes combined publication of the accepted compact four-action TUI toolbar (original action-colored bold key hints restored) and Safari's sandboxed local-note/Copy notes companion. Safari acceptance is recorded in OpenCode session ses_e3bb3ee72ffexICs8lpzmvgGkl, November 10, including the user's copied annotation saying '111 worked'. Current release-request message ID is not exposed by the harness. Excludes unrelated unpublished reference, feedback-continuation, Chrome connection/session-picker and command-consolidation changes. Third-party Lark PNGs stay local and are not redistributed.

sources.title: Customized terminal reviewer source snapshot
sources.owner: OpenCode Annotate maintainers; original MIT copyright Michael Ramos

sources.title: Integrate conversation references into opencode-annotate
sources.quote: lets do a sub function to acomodate opencode-annotate
sources.note: Approved two agent tools plus /ref as an integrated feature, verified locally. Message IDs are unavailable in the harness. Partial records that provenance gap. The approved implementation endpoint does not include publishing or changing the daily installation. Official V2 plugin/client APIs were checked against the installed 2.2.0 runtime.

sources.title: Remove the redundant reviewer repository and launch Annotate
sources.quote: @mj-project remove unwanted repo and launch this
sources.note: Authorizes releasing the integrated project and removing the previously identified nxxxsooo/plannotator-tui repository and local checkout. The subsequent launch-scope choice was Include both (Recommended), covering the TUI and conversation references. Both removals were verified on 2026-10-29 after 0.10.0 publication; recovery history is retained privately. Message IDs are not exposed by the harness.

sources.title: Include automatic review in the 0.10 release series
sources.note: The visible main session interpreted this as the 0.10 series and prepared 0.10.1, preserving already-published 0.10.0. The automatic-review handoff commit is 539493069c38f732bbce7f70a1446d0344a28df7. The later Full Save recorded the then-unpublished release candidate; the accepted blank-home web fix joins that version. Message ID is not exposed; partial records that provenance gap.
